title: Gastrointestinal Myoelectric Recordings from the Behaving Ferret
author: Charles C Horn
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6a8hahw

steps.title: Prepare Behavioral Test Chamber
steps.instruction: Prepare the 51 x 51 cm plexiglas behavioral test chamber and environment.

substeps.instruction: Cover the floor of the chamber with a layer of Alpha-dri bedding.
Turn off all lights except for the lamp over the testing chamber.
Ensure the room remains quiet during recording, except for white noise.

steps.title: Set Up Recording Equipment
steps.instruction: Position cameras and the tether system for the recording session.

substeps.instruction: Set up a Sony HDR-XR550V video camera directly above the chamber to ensure the entire area is visible with minimal shadows.
Set up a second camera to view the feeding tube from the side to track volume consumed during feeding trials.
Suspend the tether ~50 cm above the chamber and secure it with rubber bands to provide elasticity as the animal moves.

steps.title: Prepare and Acclimate Animal
steps.instruction: Prepare the animal for the recording session.

substeps.instruction: Fast the animal for 3 hours before starting the recording.
Place the animal in the chamber and allow 10 minutes for acclimation.
Connect the animal to the tether.

steps.title: Initiate Recording and Baseline
steps.instruction: Begin the data collection process using the Grapevine Neural Interface Processor and Nano2 recording headstage (Ripple LLC) and the Noldus Media Recorder.

substeps.instruction: Record electrode impedances before the recording begins.
Start electrophysiological and video recordings simultaneously.
For control days, record 1 hour of baseline data.

steps.title: Manage Tether During Testing
steps.instruction: Maintain the tether position during the session.

substeps.instruction: Hold the tether straight above the animal out of its reach, but with some slack.
If the animal attempts to grab the tether (especially during adaptation), insert a plastic straw through the breathing holes in the side of the chamber as a distraction.

steps.title: Perform Feeding Trials
steps.instruction: Execute feeding trials using Ensure liquid diet in a 100 ml Richter glass feeding tube attached to the side of the chamber.

substeps.instruction: Introduce the Ensure liquid diet 10 minutes after the start of recording.
Remove the feeding tube 45 minutes after presentation.
Finish with 10 minutes of baseline recording.

steps.title: Perform Feeding with Stimulation Trials
steps.instruction: Execute feeding trials combined with stimulation using the Grapevine Neural Interface Processor and Nano2 recording headstage.

substeps.instruction: Introduce Ensure 10 minutes after the start of recording.
Start stimulation 2 minutes after food introduction.
Stop stimulation and remove food simultaneously at minute 45 of the recording.
Finish with 10 minutes of baseline recording.

steps.title: Perform Emetine Trials
steps.instruction: Execute emetine infusion trials using the Grapevine Neural Interface Processor and Nano2 recording headstage.

substeps.instruction: Begin infusion at the 10-minute mark of the recording.
Set the infusion rate to 10ml/min.
Record for 1 hour after the infusion has ended.
Monitor the animal after recording until there is no further emesis.

steps.title: Perform Water Control Trials
steps.instruction: Perform water control trials following the same procedure as the emetine trials (Step 15), using the Grapevine Neural Interface Processor and Nano2 recording headstage.

steps.title: Conclude Recording Session
steps.instruction: Shut down the recording systems and perform final checks.

substeps.instruction: Stop electrophysiological and video recordings at the same time.
Measure impedances at the end of each recording using the Grapevine Neural Interface Processor and Nano2 recording headstage.
